# Class: `RandomForestDetector`

Evaluates validated decision trees and converts predicted regions into circles.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-droplet-detection.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_droplet_detection.py#L412) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `object`.

Averages tree probabilities over image features, then finds connected regions above the model threshold. Accepts up to two guidance circles to set image scale, or uses the model's default radius. Excludes detections that duplicate guidance or protected circles.
